title: Verify graphics capture channel parity
changes: Record a bounded three-channel graphics compare-last check with preserved guest and raw-buffer identity.
validation: An isolated EUR Wine/Xvfb session created a CLI baseline, then compare-last captures through local-control CLI, menu parameter form and interactive console. Four distinct reports retained identical guest frame, clock, state hash, registers and keys, and identical raw-buffer hashes; each comparison named the immediately previous report and reported zero raw-byte differences. Protected inputs and normal GUI closure verified.
limitations: Frontend composition depends on the visible interface and was not asserted identical. Native Windows, physical input, nondefault graphics contexts and complete DBG2-13 parity remain unverified. One attempted unit encountered an existing Wine lease before execution; no test was run in it.
